tool_fit.why: The RD/Eden paired harness exists, but two generators and the four-way discriminator must be written.

data_in_hand.why: Ten pinned specimen references and ROIs exist, although the image files themselves are absent from the checked dataset directory.

falsifiable_done.why: A locked accuracy threshold and confusion matrix make the synthetic test objective.

compute_in_repo.why: All four synthetic generators are feasible on the scientific Python stack, but two require substantive implementation.

isolation.why: The discriminator and missing generators can be added as new files with only registry additions.

time_to_verdict.why: Generator implementation, calibration, and held-out scoring are unlikely to fit one short loop.

not_blocked.why: The exact multi-feature route is untried, but the direct RD-versus-Eden precursor was non-discriminating.

evidence_for.text: The repository contains mature RD and Eden generators, specimen metadata, ROIs, and paired comparison code.
Synthetic ground-truth labels permit an unambiguous held-out classification score.

evidence_against.text: Cahn-Hilliard, buckling, and the actual discriminator are new implementations whose artifacts could dominate accuracy.
High synthetic accuracy does not ensure that heterogeneous real photographs receive a stable definite class.

problems.note: The synthetic benchmark is closeable, but the packet overstates data-in-hand: the checked dataset has pinned references rather than the ten image files. A reject or abstention rule is also needed to make the Holstein class assignment scientifically definite.

tool_fit.why: The literature scout and two-species dispersion code exist, but extraction and three-class adjudication are manual.

data_in_hand.why: The cited public literature seeds six systems, though several diffusivities may be unavailable or incomparable.

falsifiable_done.why: Six DOI-backed rows and explicit class counts are checkable, subject to rules for bounds and network topology.

compute_in_repo.why: Literature extraction and dispersion calculations need no wet lab or heavy computation.

isolation.why: The census table, analysis, and registration can be created independently.

time_to_verdict.why: Finding defensible in-vivo diffusivities across six systems is more than a routine single search.

not_blocked.why: A related zebrafish mobility prior was negative, but no census has tested this route.

evidence_for.text: The target systems and several cornerstone measurements are already named, making six classifications plausible.
The existing dispersion implementation directly tests two-node feasibility once coefficients are available.

evidence_against.text: Many systems may lack measured effective diffusivities in the relevant tissue and developmental stage.
The needs-immobile-node class cannot be inferred from a failed two-species diffusion ratio alone without a topology-specific model.

problems.note: A useful census is achievable, but class rules must distinguish unmeasured transport from evidence for a third immobile node.

tool_fit.why: Two-node Jacobian and dispersion routines exist, while the three-node topology and sampler are new.

data_in_hand.why: Published fractions and parameter bounds are cited but apparently require supplementary-material extraction.

falsifiable_done.why: The ratio, ordering, and local-retention tolerances give objective pass/fail outputs.

compute_in_repo.why: Linear-stability Latin-hypercube sweeps should run in hours on the existing stack.

isolation.why: A new sweep script and result files are naturally zero-conflict.

time_to_verdict.why: One computational loop is plausible after bounds and topology are faithfully encoded.

not_blocked.why: No recorded attempt tested parameter-volume robustness.

evidence_for.text: This is a fully computational linear-stability replication with explicit published target numbers.
The repository already provides validated two-node Jacobian and dispersion components.

evidence_against.text: Parameter-volume fractions are highly sensitive to sampling measure, bounds, and exact three-node topology.
The local 1% and 5% uncertainty protocol still needs precise reconstruction from the source.

problems.note: The result can be decisive if the published sampling measure and topology are reproduced rather than replaced by convenient repo defaults.

falsifiable_done.why: A pinned six-stage series and plus-or-minus-one stripe criterion are objective.

evidence_for.text: If a suitable series is found, the hash lock and stripe-error criterion yield a clean score.
The repository has literature, image-fitness, and prediction-registration infrastructure.

evidence_against.text: The decisive independent image series with stage-specific body lengths is not in the repository and may not exist publicly.
Repeated prior scouting documented this same acquisition gap without closing it.
The available Y-junction counting approach has a recorded over-count problem.

problems.note: The bottleneck is not computation but finding a genuinely independent, size-annotated ontogenetic series.

tool_fit.why: Only generic literature scouting exists; extraction, harmonization, and regression must be built.

data_in_hand.why: The repo templates are unusable and ten comparable taxon-level measurements require multi-paper extraction.

falsifiable_done.why: A slope and CI are checkable, but the stated verdict mapping is logically incorrect and nonexclusive.

compute_in_repo.why: The regression itself is trivial on the repository stack.

isolation.why: A new DOI-backed table and analysis can be produced without touching shared code.

time_to_verdict.why: Standardizing body size and wavelength across ten disparate taxa is not a one-loop task.

not_blocked.why: No real-data regression was attempted, but prior work established that the apparent in-repo dataset is invalid.

evidence_for.text: The literature names several systems likely to report spacing and organism dimensions.
Once a defensible table exists, a locked log-log regression gives a reproducible numerical result.

evidence_against.text: Wavelength and body-size measurements across organs and taxa are heterogeneous and may not define a common scaling relation.
The done criterion reverses the interpretations: intrinsic wavelength predicts slope zero, while proportional scaling predicts slope one; the proposed CI tests can also overlap.
The only large in-repo resource is known to be templated rather than empirical, leaving substantial manual extraction.

problems.note: The decision rule must be repaired before preregistration: test slope=0 for intrinsic wavelength and slope=1 for proportional scaling, with an explicit rule for rejecting neither or both.

tool_fit.why: Only a generic two-species rectangular RD solver is reusable; the BSW network, geometry, growth, and gradients are new.

data_in_hand.why: The published model and Hox perturbation papers are named, though full simulation parameters may require supplement reconstruction.

falsifiable_done.why: Exactly five rays in 95% of 200 runs plus an ordered dose response is precise.

compute_in_repo.why: Two hundred growing-domain three-node 2D runs may exceed hours without optimization.

isolation.why: The model can be implemented and scored in new files.

time_to_verdict.why: Faithful geometry, growth, parameterization, and ensemble validation require several iterations.

not_blocked.why: No prior repository attempt is recorded.

evidence_for.text: The target model, perturbation ordering, and numerical success threshold are unusually specific.
Published BSW and Hox studies provide a concrete implementation route without new wet data.

evidence_against.text: A faithful growing fan-domain three-node implementation is a substantial new model, not a direct reuse of the existing solver.
Published parameters may not determine boundary conditions and growth tightly enough to make 95% topology reproducibility robust.
Matching the Hox-dose polydactyly ordering adds a second calibration target that can conflict with baseline five-ray tuning.

problems.note: The criterion is decisive, but substantial model reconstruction and underdetermined boundary choices make a decisive faithful result uncertain.

tool_fit.why: The named script runs Meinhardt and Rule 30 kymographs and already computes chirality, but transducer extraction and ANF comparison are new.

data_in_hand.why: The PDE, CA controls, kymographs, and observables are all locally represented.

falsifiable_done.why: Agreement fractions and locked thresholds are objective, though thresholding and sampling conventions need specification.

compute_in_repo.why: The existing simulations and local-rule census are tractable on the current stack.

isolation.why: An extractor and result artifacts can be added as new files.

time_to_verdict.why: The core simulations already exist, leaving a bounded analysis task.

not_blocked.why: No transducer census was attempted, although existing chirality output already suggests a mechanistic mismatch.

evidence_for.text: Both source dynamics and multiple comparison observables are implemented in one mature script.
A three-bit neighborhood census is finite, transparent, and will decisively accept or reject Rule 30 agreement.
Existing code already computes Rule 30, Rule 90, Meinhardt, and specimen chirality controls.

evidence_against.text: Binary thresholding a continuous PDE can change the inferred local rule and requires a genuinely preregistered convention.
The existing implementation reports essentially symmetric Meinhardt chirality, unlike strongly chiral Rule 30, so the stated positive hypothesis is unlikely even though the test is decisive.

problems.note: This is the strongest in-repo route: it can decisively reject as well as support the proposed reduction, and current chirality diagnostics already favor rejection.

data_in_hand.why: The decisive biological replicate data are not obtainable in this repository.

falsifiable_done.why: Periodic patterning with preregistered wavelength reproducibility across three replicates is checkable.

compute_in_repo.why: A model regime map cannot substitute for constructing and assaying the circuit.

isolation.why: The required work is external wet-lab infrastructure rather than isolated repository files.

time_to_verdict.why: Circuit engineering and biological replication cannot be completed in one repository loop.

not_blocked.why: No prior repo attempt refuted the route, but this does not remove the infrastructure block.

evidence_against.text: The required intervention is wet-lab construction and the tool route explicitly says none is adequate.
The decisive replicate data cannot be generated or fetched from this repository.
A computational regime map can narrow parameters but cannot establish that a robust eukaryotic periodic circuit was realized.

problems.note: This is a clear category error for repo-only resolution; modelling can support experimental design but cannot deliver the stated verdict.

tool_fit.why: Track schema and unit conversion exist, but the central space-time spectral and surrogate test is new.

data_in_hand.why: Two substantial spark-track CSVs and related analysis tables are present locally.

falsifiable_done.why: A locked surrogate false-positive rate and per-embryo ridge test are objective.

compute_in_repo.why: Spectral fitting and phase-randomized surrogates should run in hours.

isolation.why: A spectral analysis script and registrations can be added independently.

time_to_verdict.why: A first decisive run is plausible in one sitting once the event-field estimator is specified.

not_blocked.why: Related spectral ideas were proposed but not run; prior negative blind tests concerned other features.

evidence_for.text: The repository contains thousands of timestamped spatial events in two embryo folders.
Phase-randomized surrogates provide a direct empirical null for secondary-ridge detection.
The track schema includes time, position, embryo identity, and embryo-relative coordinates.

evidence_against.text: Sparse detected event tracks are not a regularly sampled calcium field, so omega-k power estimates may be estimator-driven.
Two folders provide limited independent replication and may contain multiple tracks from the same underlying waves.
Known orientation and coordinate caveats complicate pooled directional spectra.

problems.note: The route can return a calibrated detection result, but an absent ridge should only count as decisive if power against simulated secondary ridges is preregistered.

data_in_hand.why: Public imagery is plausible, but no local dataset or guaranteed reusable point-pattern source is named.

falsifiable_done.why: Locked pair-correlation and Voronoi thresholds could be objective if identifiability is established.

evidence_for.text: Pair-correlation and Voronoi summaries admit preregistered quantitative comparisons.
Aerial imagery and published ecological models are public in principle.

evidence_against.text: Both mechanism models, the imagery dataset, segmentation, and comparison harness must be built from scratch.
The packet itself states that the proposed pattern statistics have not distinguished the mechanisms.
Vegetation feedback and termite engineering can coexist, undermining a forced one-mechanism verdict.

problems.note: The binary hypothesis is stronger than the biology supports; a mixture-model or intervention-linked dataset would be needed for mechanism identification.
